{{Top}}
'''Divorce''' was a process through which a [[Marriage/Legends|married]] couple could legally end their marriage. 

The [[Hapan]] [[Ta'a Chume]] once tried to convince her son, [[Isolder]], to divorce his wife [[Teneniel Djo]].<ref name="dj">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref> [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] also feared that his wife, [[Mirax Terrik Horn]], would divorce him after he forgot to kiss her goodbye.
